tasks.summary_pl: $h(x)=f(x)+q$ na $[-3,5]$, $h(-1)=0$. Wyznacz $q$ i pozostałe miejsca zerowe (suma)
tasks.summary_en: $h(x)=f(x)+q$ on $[-3,5]$, $h(-1)=0$. Find $q$ and the other zeros (sum)
tasks.statement_en: The figure shows the graph of function f: a broken line through points (-3,1), (-1,3), (0,2), (2,4), (5,1). The function h is defined for x in [-3,5] by h(x) = f(x) + q, where q is a real number. It is known that one of the zeros of h is x0 = -1. a) Find q. b) Give all the other zeros of h.
tasks.notes: Suma = q + pozostale miejsca zerowe = -3+1+3 = 1. [verified: ok: f(-1)=3 so q=-3; f(x)=3 also at x=1, x=3; key agrees. Sum q+1+3=1 per sum rule.]

tasks.statement_en: Among 115 people surveyed about purchases at a certain kiosk, 76 bought discounted tram tickets and 41 bought normal tram tickets; 27 of those surveyed bought both kinds of tickets. tasks.summary_en: Borys starts 10 min later, same finish time, speed +4.5 km/h. Find Adam's time
tasks.statement_en: Cross-country skier Borys set off on a race course 10 minutes later than another competitor, Adam. Both competitors reached the finish line, after covering the 15-kilometer course, at the same time. It turned out that Borys's average speed over the whole course was 4.5 km/h greater than Adam's. Calculate the time in which Adam covered the whole course.
tasks.notes: Rozwiazanie: t (czas Adama w h) spelnia 15/(t-1/6)-15/t=4.5, stad t=5/6 h = 50 min.
